typecheck-spec.//: Type-checks the spec corpus (tsconfig.spec.json) via the shared ratchet (lane-reachability rule 6 / backlog 770c0919); baseline in tools/nx-plugins/build/executors/typecheck-spec/agent-plugin-tracing.baseline.json. Wired into test.dependsOn so `nx affected -t test` runs it.

test.//: Partial override — executor/cache/outputs still come from the inferred @nx/vitest target; dependsOn is replaced wholesale, so lint/^build are relisted, plus typecheck-spec (the spec-corpus ratchet). The command is overridden because this package's vitest config is `.mts` while the workspace targetDefaults hardcodes `.ts`. No `build` dependency: the built-artifact proof is the default-running verify-dist-load gate.

build.//: Override of the `build` target inferred by @nx/js/typescript (registered for this package in nx.json). Emits CommonJS-only (tsconfig.build.json -> tsconfig.lib.json, module=commonjs) into {projectRoot}/dist/index.js + index.d.ts per adhd ADR-0003; rootDir=src so the entry lands at dist/index.js. tsconfig.build.json maps the one workspace dep (@adhd/agent-base-types) to its BUILT declaration, which ^build guarantees, so compilation never depends on an optional per-package node_modules symlink (adhd ADR-0002). Same shape as agent-core-native-tooling.
